Hi all —

Quick runbook answers for Acme Health's asks (high level; happy to do a 30m deep dive):

1) Subprocessors and content- Subprocessors that may see raw content: 
   - Cloud infra: AWS (us-east-1, us-west-2) for hosted tenants; customers on Private/Dedicated can run in their VPC.
   - Log aggregation / monitoring: Sumo Logic (ingests service logs), and our optional telemetry pipeline to Amplitude for product metrics.
   - Model infra partners (in some dedicated configurations): XCloud Inference (managed runtime) — only used for capacity tiers where customers opt-in.
   - Note: By default our analytics pipeline collects usage-level metrics (latency, success/failure, token counts). We do NOT send raw customer content to analytics providers unless explicit opt-in (rare).

2) Retention- Defaults: raw input retention = 30 days for hosted API (configurable); logs/trace retention = 90 days.
   - Options: for pilot we can enable 30-day auto-delete of all raw inputs and shorten logs to 30 days via account settings; we can also implement immediate deletion hooks for dedicated/private customers via config.

3) Telemetry controls and logging- We offer account-level toggles to disable the optional telemetry pipeline. Access logs that record request metadata (timestamp, model, token counts) are retained as above and can be provided via secure S3 export for audits. We support field-level redaction in request logging (customer-configurable) so sensitive fields can be masked before being persisted.

4) Data residency- Hosted tenants can be pinned to US regions; for stricter controls we recommend Redwood Dedicated or Private options where processing and storage remain inside the customer's VPC/region. We can provide an attestation of region restriction and an architecture diagram for the pilot.

5) Evidence / DPA- SOC 2 Type II: redacted report available under NDA. We also have a standard DPA template; Laura can advise on any customer-specific edits.

Attachments: subprocessors_matrix.csv, privacy_one-pager.pdf.

Next steps I propose:
- Provide the subprocessors_matrix and SOC2 evidence under NDA.
- Schedule a 30m technical deep-dive (Vivek + infra engineer) to walk through telemetry controls and residency options.
- Provide DPA draft for legal review.

Happy to join a meeting next week (Mon/Tue windows open).

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Security & Product Trust, Redwood Inference

- Retention: raw input default = 30 days (configurable); logs = 90 days (can be shortened to 30 for the pilot).
